description: Live game loop (client/game.py --check), TPC-DOOM E1M1 1,200 tics, warm-up 120 excluded; period = tic (run_tic + commit + sound events + finish) + camera_pose + frame (serial), or the time between tic starts (pipelined). Budget 1000/35 = 28.571 ms. All runs: 1200/1200 live frames pixel-exact vs CedarDB, camera poses equal. *_r3_baseline = round-3 renderer (variants/p0) + phase-1 tic (variants/g0) measured the same day on the same host.
